title.hr: Sprega u bliskom polju: indukcija bez zračenja

concept.hr: Blizu napon pada kao 1/r³, kao u transformatoru; iza λ/2π preuzima zračenje, 1/r
concept.en: Close in the voltage falls as 1/r³, like a transformer; past λ/2π radiation, 1/r

summary.hr: Dvije male petlje, 5 cm do 1 km, 100 kHz do 450 MHz: napon na log–log prikazu prelazi s 1/r³ na 1/r kod λ/2π; na osi blizu jači, daleko nikakav.
summary.en: Two small loops, 5 cm to 1 km, 100 kHz to 450 MHz: on a log–log plot the voltage turns from 1/r³ to 1/r at λ/2π; on the axis stronger close in, nil far out.
